entries.22e89b9c1d7bcf6e: This business develops, manufactures, sells and maintains process equipment for electronic device manufacturing, such as semiconductors and liquid crystal displays, and related peripheral equipment. The Semiconductor Equipment division handles coating equipment, developing equipment and equipment for advanced packaging, and its main product is the Wafer Support System compatible with various wafers. The Transfer Equipment division handles industrial robots that transfer wafers between semiconductor manufacturing processes and their units, the Cleaning Equipment division handles single-wafer cleaning equipment and batch immersion cleaning equipment, and the Coater division handles color filter manufacturing equipment for TFT color liquid crystal displays. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥27,475 million.

entries.74972ead5bc4a5d1: Aiming to provide products with the performance customers require, at the right time and at appropriate prices, it actively pursues diversified, global business development under its corporate motto, “Challenge.” It has been developing its business based on the “TAZMO Group Medium-Term Management Plan (TAZMO Vision 2025),” announced on February 13, 2023. While centered on the process equipment business, which comprises semiconductor manufacturing equipment and transport equipment, it aims to grow through joint development of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and synergy effects, leveraging the technology and facilities of Facility Co., Ltd. and Quark Technology Co., Ltd., and it will focus research and development on business-oriented areas.
